name: Sunset
description: Andrew Mitchell's free patron edition for System Obeyed vs System Broken, the first live show at the 4096 gallery. Minted only to the wallets that signed the guestbook while his window was open. One per wallet, never sold. The mint is the signature: the holders of this edition are the record of who was there. The image lives permanently on-chain in the Sunsets contract at 0x81f7876221C0bA48832f2a8019A2191c9773D33d; this file mirrors those exact bytes.
